justification: Response focuses on routing protocols and a non‑existent BDSR algorithm rather than core link‑budget parameters (EIRP, antenna gain, G/T, margin). It misstates that higher‑order modulation mitigates latency and ignores power, noise, rain fade considerations. While it mentions latency, it does not tie to the reference context about parallel terrestrial links. Consequently, technical depth and actionable guidance are weak.
